subject: GTM scaling proposal: EMEA seat approval request
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-14T17:12:00Z
Subject: GTM scaling proposal: EMEA seat approval request

Hi team,

I'm proposing a small, targeted expansion for EMEA to support the Q3 pipeline and three priority named accounts. Summary below — requesting approval to open the roles and authorize offer bands so recruiting can start outreach and offers the week of Feb 22.

Ask: approve 4 FTEs (two SDRs, one AE, one Solutions Engineer) for EMEA region and sign off on the attached comp bands. Hiring plan: 2 SDRs (regional inbound/partner coverage), 1 AE (mid-market, quota 1.2M ARR), 1 SE (pre-sales coverage for EMEA enterprise accounts). Proposed start window: Mar 15–May 1 (staggered).

Comp bands (base / OTE):
- SDR (EMEA I): base 42k–48k EUR / OTE 72k–80k EUR
- SDR (EMEA II - senior): base 55k–62k EUR / OTE 100k–115k EUR
- AE (Mid-market): base 75k–85k EUR / OTE 150k–170k EUR (accelerators tied to net new ARR)
- SE (Enterprise): base 90k–105k EUR / OTE 170k–190k EUR

Justification: Q3 pipeline shows three accounts (total TCV ~4.1M ARR over next 12 months) currently backed by US-based SDRs with timezone coverage gaps. Adding two local SDRs and an SE will reduce sales cycle by 20–30% on average and increase conversion on the named accounts we're forecasting to close in Q3.

Budget: This fits inside the Q2 committed hiring envelope (code: GTM-EMEA-Q2). We've modeled blended cost including taxes and benefits; detailed numbers in the attached spreadsheet.

Attachments: 2027-02-14_EMEA_headcount_request.xlsx (breakdown by month, cost, ramp), comp-bands_EMEA-q2-2027.pdf

If approved, recruiting will: reopen 1 active AE req (REQ-4821), create two SDR reqs and one SE req, begin targeted outreach and RPS sourcing.

Next steps I'm hoping for:
- Approve seat counts and bands (Marissa)
- Finance confirmation on budget code (Neha)
- Rishi sign-off on quota & ramp assumptions

Happy to hop on a 20-min sync if helpful — otherwise please reply with approvals/changes.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Senior Recruiting Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-02-15T14:22:00Z
Subject: Re: GTM scaling proposal: EMEA seat approval request

Mina — thanks for the write-up and the attachment. I have a few quick clarifying questions before I can sign off:

1) Quota & ramp assumptions for the new AE: you list 1.2M quota and a 6-month ramp to 80% attainment. Are we modeling 50% attainment in month 3 and 80% by month 6? Please paste the monthly ramp table from the workbook in the thread.
2) SDR coverage split by sub-region: which markets do the two SDRs cover? Are we prioritizing DACH + Nordics or UK + Benelux? This changes comp expectations.
3) Time-to-hire risk: recruiting SLA shows 8–10 weeks; if offers are accepted late March, start date could compress. How does that affect Q3 forecasting?

Neha — please confirm the budget code (GT M-EMEA-Q2?) and whether the blended cost fits within committed spend for the quarter. If we need a SWF approval, flag it.

Mina, if you can reply with the ramp table and regional split I can confirm quota & headcount by EOD tomorrow.

-Rishi
GTM Operations Lead

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-15T18:05:00Z
Subject: Re: GTM scaling proposal: EMEA seat approval request

Rishi — thanks. Answers inline and I've pasted the ramp table excerpt below as requested. Also added the regional coverage notes.

1) Ramp table (AE REQ-4821):
- Month 1: 25% quota attainment
- Month 2: 40%
- Month 3: 55%
- Month 4: 70%
- Month 5: 80%
- Month 6+: 100%
(We used a conservative 6-month model; the finance sheet computes ARR impact under both 6- and 9-month ramps.)

2) SDR split: Primary coverage will be UK & Benelux (SDR I), DACH & Nordics (SDR II — senior). Rationale: the named accounts require localized outreach (German + Dutch language coverage for DACH/Benelux). Comp bands above reflect the senior SDR premium for SDR II.

3) Time-to-hire: recruiting SLA shows 6–9 weeks if we prioritize sourcer time and pull warm pipeline; that's why I'm asking to approve bands this week so we can move fast. If offers land late March, we modeled two scenarios in the workbook — best-case Q3 contribution assumes the AE ramps to 70% in Q3; downside assumes 50% (reflected in revenue model).

Budget code: Neha — confirming we intended GTM-EMEA-Q2.

Quick ask for approvals:
- Marissa: please approve headcount and comp bands (SDR I/II, AE, SE) so we can start offers.
- Neha: confirm budget code & that blended comp fits the commitment.

Link to docs: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cEMEAHeadcount

Attachments included in the earlier mail.

Thanks,
Mina

Approved — thanks Mina & Rishi for the quick turnaround. Two small edits before recruiting kicks off: 

1) Increase AE OTE pacing by 5% at the midpoint (to allow for targeted AE SOCs tied to named-account incentives). Please update the comp-bands PDF and re-upload.
2) For the senior SDR (SDR II), include a discretionary sign-on for relocation support up to 6k EUR (if needed). Finance, if this is acceptable please confirm.

Neha — can you confirm budget fit and whether we need a formal SWF for the sign-on? Otherwise Mina, proceed with req creation and offer templates; coordinate with hiring manager on start windows.

Marissa Cole
